title: If any person fails to take action as
text:
356G.

If any person fails to take action as
required by a notice served on him
under sub-section (1) of section 356J.

356G(2) The master of the ship shall
be liable to fine which may
extend to one thousand
rupees.

356J(1). The offender shall be liable
to penalty of imprisonment
which may extend to six
months or fine which may
extend to ten lakh rupees or
both.
